e.title: AWS GNN 实时欺诈检测
e.summary: AWS 官方 GNN 实时欺诈蓝图（226★）：Neptune 图库 + SageMaker + DGL 异构图，IEEE-CIS 数据集
e.body: realtime-fraud-detection-with-gnn-on-dgl（awslabs，226★）是 AWS 官方端到端实时欺诈检测蓝图：用图数据库 Amazon Neptune 把表格数据构建成异构交易图，Deep Graph Library（DGL）训练 GNN，在 IEEE-CIS 欺诈检测数据集上识别欺诈交易；含模型训练/部署栈、实时检测栈与交易仪表盘栈（CloudFormation 一键部署）。对 RIAA：图数据库+GNN 的反欺诈生产级参考架构——与 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]（可解释欺诈流水线）、[[networkfraud]]（保险欺诈网络论文代码）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 图检测入门）互补；生产部署视角可与 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（Microsoft 理赔反欺诈 demo）对照。

e.title_hk: AWS GNN 實時欺詐檢測
e.summary_en: AWS official real-time GNN fraud blueprint (226★): Neptune graph DB + SageMaker + DGL heterogeneous graph on IEEE-CIS
e.summary_hk: AWS 官方 GNN 實時欺詐藍圖（226★）：Neptune 圖庫 + SageMaker + DGL 異構圖，IEEE-CIS 數據集
e.body_en: realtime-fraud-detection-with-gnn-on-dgl (awslabs, 226★) is an AWS official end-to-end blueprint for real-time fraud detection: it uses the graph database Amazon Neptune to build a heterogeneous transaction graph from tabular data, trains a GNN with the Deep Graph Library (DGL) to detect fraudulent transactions on the IEEE-CIS fraud dataset, and ships model training/deployment stacks, a real-time detection stack and a transaction dashboard stack (one-click CloudFormation deployment). For RIAA: a production-grade reference architecture for fraud detection with graph DB + GNN — complements [[explainable-ai-fraud]] (explainable fraud pipeline), [[networkfraud]] (insurance fraud network paper code) and [[aws-fraud-graph]] (AWS graph-detection starter); compare the production angle with [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (Microsoft claims-fraud demo).
e.body_hk: realtime-fraud-detection-with-gnn-on-dgl（awslabs，226★）是 AWS 官方端到端實時欺詐檢測藍圖：用圖數據庫 Amazon Neptune 把表格數據構建成異構交易圖，Deep Graph Library（DGL）訓練 GNN，在 IEEE-CIS 欺詐檢測數據集上識別欺詐交易；含模型訓練/部署棧、實時檢測棧與交易儀表盤棧（CloudFormation 一鍵部署）。對 RIAA：圖數據庫+GNN 的反欺詐生產級參考架構——與 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]（可解釋欺詐流水線）、[[networkfraud]]（保險欺詐網絡論文程式碼）、[[aws-fraud-graph]]（AWS 圖檢測入門）互補；生產部署視角可與 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（Microsoft 理賠反欺詐 demo）對照。
